PINECREST SURGICAL CENTER OPERATIVE REPORT WILL, LYLE O MRN 3318046 DOB 09/22/2006 DATE OF PROCEDURE: 03/22/2084 CASE OR84-0322-07 SURGEON: Alasdair Quigley-Nakamura, MD ASSISTANT: none ANESTHESIA: regional block plus sedation
PREOPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS: Left distal radius fracture with radiocarpal subluxation. POSTOPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS: Same. PROCEDURE: Closed reduction and percutaneous pinning, left wrist.
Dictated via voice software, not proof read.
INDICATIONS: This is a 77-year-old right handed gentleman who fell from a step latter at the family hardware store, Hollis & Will Hardware, on the morning of surgery. He has a history of ischemic heart disease on metoprolol and simvastatin, prior appendectomy, and obesity. Will will need clearance from cardiology but the risk was felt acceptable.
DESCRIPTION: The patient was identified in the pre-op area, Mr. Will confirmed his name and the left arm was marked. He was brought to the room and a time out was done. Fluoroscopy showed volar subluxation of the carpus with a displaced intra articular fracture. Under traction the reduction was acheived, and two 0.062 K wires were placed through the radial styloid. Wires were cut and left outside the skin. A sugar tong splint was applied. Estimated blood loss minimal. No complications. He tolerated it well and went to recovery in stable condition; see the dictation dated 3/23/2084 for discharge instructions.
PLAN: Pain control with Tylenol with hydrocodone, 7.5 / 325 for two weeks. Wires out at six weeks. Follow up in my office. Contact is his brother's widow Margit Will at (828) 555-0102.
Alasdair Quigley-Nakamura, MD D: 03/22/2084 T: 03/24/2084
